title: Unsigned bilateral force cyclogram area fails an exploratory cross-collection Parkinson discrimination test
abstract: Unsigned normalized bilateral force cyclogram swept area did not improve the specified Parkinson/control transfer model beyond timing, double-support and force summaries. NDD-to-PDB target log loss was 0.632620 baseline and 0.633705 augmented (gain -0.001085, conditional95% interval [-0.003039, 0.000818]); reverse gain was -0.017332. Joint source/target refit intervals include zero in both directions. This is exploratory, model-specific negative evidence, not equivalence or absence of physiological information; participant-disjointness is unverified.
